title: Constant-Depth Quantum Barrier Option Pricing via a Static Bivariate Oracle Framework
summary: Quantum amplitude estimation offers a theoretical quadratic speedup over classical Monte Carlo methods for financial derivative pricing. However, extending gate-based algorithms to path-dependent barrier options has historically been hampered by sequential path discretization, where tracking price paths across $d$ monitoring dates incurs a linear escalation in qubit footprint and gate depth ($\mathcal{O}(d)$), posing severe coherence challenges for near-term quantum processors.
